searched.title: Bambu Hotend - X1C (store page)
searched.note: The P0 corpus copy, parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload, manifest row); offline. Product Specifications (two 4-cell rows): Max. Printing Temp. 320 ℃, Length 47.3 mm, Packaging Weight "40 g/30 g" and Packaging Size 190*70*50 mm; no width, height, net weight, flow rate or electrical value. The Size values give each option's nozzle diameter and material; In the Box has one column per Hotend Type value; the Filament Compatibility table (16 rows × 4 nozzle sizes plus "Hardened Steel Required?") and its three notes give the material relations. The meta description's "X1 Series" is not used as a compatibility target (the wiki table names X1C only).

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The "X1/P1 Series Nozzle" panel and the compatibility rows "X1C Hotend" / "X1C Complete Hotend Assembly" name this product. It agrees with the store page on the sizes ("Size: 0.2mm/ 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm"), the materials ("Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel") and the max temperature (320 ℃); the per-option diameter and material come from the store page's option values (official_variant; recorded in specs from the store page). It states no dimensions, weight, flow rate or electrical value for this product. The 300°C rating of the "X1/P1 Series Hotend Silicone Sock" belongs to that separate product and is not stored here.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: A general guide for every Bambu nozzle (it includes high-flow columns this product does not have), so none of its rows is stored as a spec of this product; it is used only to flag disagreements with the store page's own Filament Compatibility table (see the relations' conflict notes). Its nozzle guidelines also say to avoid stainless steel for particle-filled filaments (PLA Marble, PLA Sparkle), while the store table marks hardened steel "Optional" for them; on this product the only stainless option (0.2 mm) is "*NO" for those rows, so no relation is affected.
